Name: Jehoshabeath, Daughter of Jehoram
Role: Daughter of the King; Wife of Jehoiada
Summary: Jehoshabeath, daughter of King Jehoram and wife of Jehoiada the priest, stole the baby Joash from among the king's sons being slain and hid him and his nurse in a bedchamber from Athaliah.
KeyStory: Jehoshabeath, sister of Ahaziah, hid Joash in the house of God six years while Athaliah reigned over the land.
RelatedPeople: Jehoram, King of Judah; Jehoiada, the Priest; Joash, King of Judah
LifeLesson: One woman's courage preserved David's line and the promise with it.
